query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: A high entropy alloy coating can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix to enhance its wear resistance.
generation.structural_mediator: Interfacial bonding between Cu and high entropy alloy
generation.mechanism: Formation of a strong and stable interface between the Cu matrix and the high entropy alloy coating, leading to improved wear resistance
generation.predicted_outcome: Enhanced wear resistance of the Cu matrix
generation.baseline: Wear resistance of uncoated Cu matrix
generation.boundary: Deposition conditions, coating thickness, and high entropy alloy composition
generation.uncertainty: The exact composition and deposition conditions of the high entropy alloy coating, as well as the potential for interfacial reactions or defects

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the wear resistance of coated and uncoated Cu matrices under controlled conditions
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the wear resistance of the coated Cu matrix is not significantly improved compared to the uncoated Cu matrix, the hypothesis is falsified
